_comment: MOCK DATA -- illustrative values, NOT real forecasts. This is exactly what GET /api/v1/risk/current?district=aizawl will return from Vishwajeet's V9 step. Riya builds the whole dashboard against this file and swaps in the live URL later -- zero code change, because the shape is identical.

meta._comment_demo: is_demo_data: true -> the UI MUST render a visible orange 'DEMO DATA' banner. This flag is the single switch that keeps us honest. When real data flows, the backend sets it false and the banner disappears by itself.

summary._comment_lead_time: lead_time_hours = valid_from minus run_ts. This is the number that actually matters -- it is how much warning a district officer gets.

properties._comment_three_fields: probability / risk_level / verification_status are THREE SEPARATE FIELDS. Riya must render them in three separate places. Never colour the map by probability and call it risk.

properties._comment_field_report: A citizen crack report exists for this unit. It RAISES the probability -- tension cracks are one of the very few visible precursors of slope failure. This is why requirement (e) is scientific, not decorative.

snake_line._comment: The snake line: cumulative short-term rainfall on X, long-term soil wetness on Y. The trajectory wriggles like a snake as it moves through the last 72 hours. Where it crosses the critical curve, the slope enters a failure state. Riya: this is a Recharts scatter+line chart. It is the best 20 seconds of the demo -- never cut it.
snake_line._comment_forecast: is_forecast: true points are the FORECAST tail -- draw them as a dashed line. The solid part is what already happened; the dashed part is where the rainfall forecast says the slope is heading. The lead time IS the dashed part.
